title: kit.content-tags.v1
description: A project's content-tag vocabulary (tags.config.json): the ONE place a topic tag is defined. Every podcast series, episode item and blog post names its tags by id from this file and from no other source; a series' tags are inherited by its episodes unless an episode names its own. A tag carries a label per locale, a group, a colour ROLE (a tone of the project's tokens: chart1 to chart6, accent, ok, warn, err; never a literal colour: the text on it is the derived on-<role>, proven AA by the colour canon) and a description. Cross-file rules (every assigned tag is declared, every series and post has tags, every label covers the project's locales) are checked by `kit check tags`.

locales.description: The locales every label and description covers; the first is the fallback.

group.description: A group id of this file.

colour.description: A tone role of the project's tokens (the fills that have a derived on-<role> text colour); never a hex or rgb value.
